## Summary
Generate 3 plausible distractors per item using Haiku, each anchored to a MisconceptionCategory from the knowledge graph to ensure pedagogic value.

## User story
As a pipeline step, I need to generate misconception-anchored distractors for each item, so that wrong answers reveal specific student misunderstandings rather than being randomly incorrect.

## Why this matters
Distractors are the diagnostic core of MCQs. If distractors are implausible, students can eliminate them without knowing the material (item difficulty artificially low). If distractors aren't anchored to MisconceptionCategories, the system can't diagnose which specific misconceptions a student holds, breaking the adaptive learning feedback loop.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Generates exactly 3 distractors per item
- [ ] Each distractor anchored to a MisconceptionCategory node from Neo4j (15 seeded in E01-S07)
- [ ] Distractor prompt loaded from packages/ai/prompts/distractor.md via loadPrompt
- [ ] Model: HAIKU_MODEL (cost-efficient for distractor generation)
- [ ] Input: stem + key + context from E05-S05
- [ ] Output shape: `{ distractors: [{ text, misconceptionCategoryId, rationale }] }`
- [ ] Distractors must not overlap with the key (automatic check)
- [ ] Distractors must be clinically plausible but incorrect
- [ ] All Claude responses parsed with safeJsonParse (Rule 2)
- [ ] Batch items processed with Promise.allSettled (Rule 3)
- [ ] MisconceptionCategory lookup via neo4jQuery (Rule 1)
- [ ] Context sanitized via sanitizeForContext (Rule 5)

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// apps/inngest/functions/p3-steps/generate-distractors.ts
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client';
import { safeJsonParse } from '@journey/ai/safe-parse';
import { HAIKU_MODEL } from '@journey/ai/constants';
import { sanitizeForContext, buildContextBlock } from '@journey/ai/sanitize';
import { loadPrompt } from '@journey/ai/prompts';

export async function generateDistractors(
  items: GeneratedItem[],
  contextWindow: string
): Promise<ItemWithDistractors[]> {
  // Load misconception categories from Neo4j
  const categories = await neo4jQuery(
    'MATCH (mc:MisconceptionCategory) RETURN mc.uuid AS id, mc.name AS name, mc.description AS desc'
  );

  const distractorPrompt = await loadPrompt('distractor');

  // Generate distractors for all items in parallel
  const results = await Promise.allSettled(
    items.map(item => generateItemDistractors(item, categories, distractorPrompt, contextWindow))
  );

  return results
    .filter((r): r is PromiseFulfilledResult<ItemWithDistractors> => r.status === 'fulfilled')
    .map(r => r.value);
}

async function generateItemDistractors(
  item: GeneratedItem,
  categories: MisconceptionCategory[],
  prompt: string,
  context: string
): Promise<ItemWithDistractors> {
  const sanitized = sanitizeForContext(JSON.stringify({ stem: item.stem, key: item.key }));
  const itemContext = buildContextBlock('item_data', sanitized);

  const response = await callClaude(HAIKU_MODEL, prompt, itemContext);
  const { data } = safeJsonParse<DistractorResponse>(response);

  // Validate: no distractor text matches the key
  const validDistractors = data.distractors.filter(d => d.text !== item.key);

  return { ...item, distractors: validDistractors };
}
```
